Few in number, they use cutting edge armour and weapons, customized to their exact specifications. They serve as the Conduit’s personal guard and emissaries, delivering his orders and enforcing his will directly. The Custodians depend heavily upon their reputation and the trust that others invest in them. In order to maintain their status, they have slowly embraced intricate honour ceremonies, destructive rivalries and webs of lies and secrets. During his rise to power, the Founder established an entourage of trusted acolytes. Each member was an individual of intelligence and skill whom the Founder trusted implicitly. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/custodian-brothers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Guardian: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away and take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). ### Special Rules Dash: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Guardian Boost: If all models in this unit have Guardian, enemy hits always count as having AP(-1) from Guardian (instead of only when being shot/charged from over 9" away). Hit & Run Shooter: Once per round, units where all models have this rule may move by up to 3" after shooting. Piercing Target(X): Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. Friendly units get +AP(X) on their weapons when attacking it. Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Shred Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Shred when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply). Steadfast: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken. Tear: Against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+4). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Dash Aura: This model and its unit get Dash. Guardian Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Guardian Boost. Hit & Run Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get Hit & Run Shooter. Ranged Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Shred when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Shred when shooting. Steadfast Aura: This model and its unit get Steadfast. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Unstoppable in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Unstoppable in melee. Read more ### Spells The Founder's Curse (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Shred when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply). Thunderous Mist (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits. Focused Defender (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Unpredictable Fighter once (next time the effect would apply). Dread Strike (2): Pick one enemy model within 24", which takes 2 hits with Tear. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Guardian Protection (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Guardian Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Mind Gash (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred. ### Units ### Heroes Master Destroyer [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 250pts Flame-Mount(12", A1, Blast(3), Reliable),
